name: Herd Animal, Grangeri
body:
Grangeri
CR 7

N Huge animal
Init +6; Senses low-light vision; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 16; touch 9, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, -2 size, +7 natural)
hp 82 (13d8+46)
Fort +15, Ref +9, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee Bite +15 (2d6+8)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 12, Con 21, Int 1, Wis 9, Cha 9
Base Atk +9; CMB +17; CMD 28
Feats: Alertness, Great Fortitude, Improved Natural Armor (x3), Toughness (x2)
Skills: Perception +11, Stealth +12
Languages: None

ECOLOGY

Environment Warm hills and grasslands
Organization Solitary or herd (2-6)
Treasure None

The grangeri looks like a cross between a giraffe and a hornless rhinoceros. Its long neck allows it to reach for and eat leaves from the tops of trees. A grangeri is about 30 feet long and stands 20 feet tall.
